environment.description: Go microservice deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) with direct internet-facing ALB passthrough. No origin validation beyond the permissive CheckOrigin. Service is accessible on port 8080 via ALB TCP listener (layer 4 only). Tokens are issued by a separate auth service and passed via query parameter. No network segmentation between public internet and the service.

config.network: ALB TCP passthrough on port 443->8080, public subnet
config.auth_service: separate container issuing HMAC tokens valid for current rotation window
config.tls: ALB terminates TLS, plaintext to backend
